Nav Computer Walk Sheet

Every screen of the nav computer, in all three looks, with every control it has and what should happen when you use it. Tick each row as you go and write what you saw. I read the ticks and notes back next session.

Screenshots taken live from lane A (feature/world-engine-production-L1) at 876b540, in Sol, 417×240 texels, then enlarged. Legacy shots are half size.

Opening the nav

The nav computer is a full-screen overlay. It opens on the screen you last used, in the look you last used.

StepDo thisWhat should happen
1Splash → ORRERY → hold D into SolThe ship is in Sol. The nav needs a real system under it, or the SYSTEM screen is disabled (see below).
2NThe nav opens (sound plays). It opens on SYSTEM after an arrival.
3VCycles the look: Legacy → Design 1 → Design 2 → Legacy. The choice is remembered across sessions.
4N or EscCloses the nav. If a warp was committed with Enter, the warp starts on close.
Design 1 is the one Max named "the 71×40": a square map beside a ranked list. Design 2 is "two bars and a sky": the map bleeds to the edges, one bar on top, one on the bottom. Legacy is the pre-redesign nav drawn at full resolution.

Keys that work everywhere

These work on every screen unless the row says otherwise. Mouse gestures differ per screen and are listed under each one.

KeyDoesWhich looks
NOpen / close the nav. Blocked on the title screen and during a warp.all
EscIf the search is open, closes only the search. Otherwise closes the nav. It never steps back a screen.all
VNext look (Legacy → Design 1 → Design 2). Works even from Legacy.all
Tab / Shift+TabNext / previous screen, wrapping GALAXY ↔ SYSTEM. Skips SYSTEM when the ship is in no system. Not bound in Legacy: there you click the tab strip.designs 1+2
EnterCommit: fires the warp or burn shown in the commit row. On a search result, warps to it. Does nothing at SYSTEM with nothing selected.designs 1+2
[ / ]Previous / next sort key for the list on this screen (the hint row names the current key). Goes back to the first page.designs 1+2
- / =Page the list back / forward one screenful.designs 1+2
/Open the drawn search. In Legacy the search box is always on screen, top-left: click into it.designs 1+2
LPRISM only: swap between the star map and the star list.design 2
, / .SYSTEM only: step the ladder one stop left / right. Only exists when the ladder overflows, which Sol's does not.design 1
W A S DPRISM only: pan the camera through the star column while held.all
R / FPRISM only: raise / lower the camera above or below the galactic plane.all
Mouse wheelPRISM: zoom in / out. SYSTEM: zoom in Legacy only; both designs ignore it (known gap).all
↑ / ↓, BackspaceWhile the search is open: move the highlight, delete a letter.all
Right-clickLegacy "go back one screen" route. The code path may be dead in current Chrome. Worth one try.legacy
While the drawn search is open, every key goes into the search box, including V, Tab and N. Close it with Esc first.

Search

Type a name, pick a result, warp. The same catalogue answers in every look: real stars, known systems, named systems near you.

Between screens

Every move between screens should animate. These are the durations the code runs; "cuts" means you should see a snap, which is a defect.

Known gaps

Things the record already names as short of the goal. Testing them again is not needed; seeing one is not a new defect.

  • KNOWN GAP The commit row (design 1) and the [WARP] chip (design 2) are drawn on every screen but answer a click only at SYSTEM. On the other screens only Enter commits.
  • KNOWN GAP The mouse wheel at SYSTEM does nothing in either design (Legacy zooms).
  • KNOWN GAP Dragging the 2D map in a design pans, but the pan speed is Legacy's scale, not the design's, so it feels a little off.
  • KNOWN GAP Design 2's GALAXY band shows about half the disc; 20 of 775 sectors are off the glass until you drag. A letterbox is open ruling 5 below.
  • KNOWN GAP Design 2 SYSTEM: the ship diamond sits at a fixed offset from the star and does not move when you rotate the orrery. Not clickable.
  • KNOWN GAP Design 1 SYSTEM: the habitable-zone band stays on true AU while crowded bodies are pushed apart, so a body can sit beside the band rather than in it.
  • KNOWN GAP The first entry into PRISM after opening stutters for about half a second (the star load); the ease looks stretched once. Warm, it is clean.
  • KNOWN GAP In a design, clicking a planet in a foreign system (one you browsed to, not the one you are in) does nothing at all.
  • KNOWN GAP Design 1's status row collides with itself below ~300 texels wide. Not at your window size.
  • INERT Still drawn with no click behaviour, by omission not decision: design 1's detail block under the list, both hint rows, design 2's status line, the list's density bars, the HZ band.

  2. HERE · SECTOR at SYSTEM does nothing. Should it jump back to the system you are in when you have browsed to a foreign one? recommend: park
  3. There is no zoom gauge on the PRISM to grab; design 2 prints the zoom as a number. Draw one, or close the "grabbable indicators" item as is? recommend: close
